booking-count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM bookings

capacity-left.sql: SELECT capacity - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings WHERE bookings.course_id = courses.id) AS left FROM courses WHERE id = 'course-1'

waitlist-head.sql: SELECT account FROM waitlist WHERE course_id = 'course-1' ORDER BY position ASC LIMIT 1

waitlist-order.sql: SELECT account FROM waitlist WHERE course_id = 'course-1' ORDER BY position ASC

booking-holder.sql: SELECT account FROM bookings WHERE course_id = 'course-1' AND account NOT IN ('holder_rc','holder2_rc') ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
